sources.title: FreedomIntelligence/AceGPT-v2-32B-Chat · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: AceGPT AceGPT is a fully fine-tuned generative text model collection, particularly focused on the Arabic language domain. This is the repository for the version 2 of the 32B-chat pre-trained model, developed based on AceGPT-v2-32B.

sources.title: AceGPT V2 32B Chat by FreedomIntelligence
sources.snippet: AceGPT V2 32B Chat is an open-source 32b LLM by FreedomIntelligence. VRAM 64.6GB, 32K context. Compare benchmarks, capabilities, and deployment details on LLM Explorer.

sources.title: FreedomIntelligence/AceGPT-v2-32B-Chat - toolify.ai
sources.snippet: AceGPT-v2-32B-Chat is an open source model from GitHub that offers a free installation service, and any user can find AceGPT-v2-32B-Chat on GitHub to install. At the same time, huggingface.co provides the effect of AceGPT-v2-32B-Chat install, users can directly use AceGPT-v2-32B-Chat installed effect in huggingface.co for debugging and trial.
